brief: A storage box whose lid is held shut with magnets.

requirements.evidence: piece:0,0,0;full base with 6 side caps and cover:0,0,0;full;top forming closed box
Top cover BOM includes 6× Neodymium disc magnet Ø5×1mm + 6× steel BB for magnetic catch; cover snaps shut magnetically (setCoverMagnets already active, NO_CHANGE)

finish.summary: Single hex cell storage box: full base with all side faces capped and a full top cover as lid. The lid uses integrated magnetic catch (6 magnets + BBs per BOM) to hold shut.
